callouts.text:
PRICE CAME TO THE ZONE
4,387 → 4,350 today, −1.31%

points: Gold fell 1.31% today to 4,349.92 — dropping toward the 4,300–4,340 pullback zone flagged when it was 4,387. The measured move had already completed at 4,384, so this is the pause arriving on schedule.
LONG: enter 4,325 in the zone, stop 4,268 just under it, first target 4,460 at the base of the supply shelf. Risk 57 for reward 135 — 2.4R.
Stop placement is the whole trade. Put the stop under key support at 4,180 instead and the same idea risks 145 to make 135 — 0.9R, not worth taking. Same thesis, half the geometry.
SHORT: not live. Only on a daily close below 4,180, which puts price back inside the base. Then 4,175 entry, 4,235 stop, 4,050 target — 2.1R.
summary.bias: Trend bias: BULLISH while above 4,200 — the long is the trade, the short is the hedge against being wrong
summary.invalidation: a daily close below 4,268 kills the long setup; below 4,180 flips the structure and arms the short
